description: Register a coffee that is NOT yet in list_beans, together with its first bag, and make it the active coffee. The coffee is the roaster's product (roaster, origins, variety, process, roast level, roasting type, cupping score, aromatics, roaster notes, rest window); the bag is this purchase (roast date, weight, price, state). For another bag of a coffee already on file call register_bag instead — it keeps the recipes and notes. Returns bean_id and the first bag's bag_id.

acidity.description: Free text; roasters usually say low, medium or high

arabica_pct.description: Percent arabica, 100 for a pure arabica; the rest robusta

attachments.description: JSON or comma-separated list of attachments

best_by_date.description: Calendar day in YYYY-MM-DD format — a day, not a timestamp

body.description: Free text; roasters usually say low, medium or high

buy_date.description: Calendar day in YYYY-MM-DD format — a day, not a timestamp

dial_category.description: Dialing behavior class: classic = medium/traditional espresso roasts (chocolate/nut, balanced); dark = genuinely dark/roasty; the light categories cover Nordic and ultra-light styles.

frozen_at.description: Calendar day the bag went into the freezer, YYYY-MM-DD — a day, not a timestamp

notes.description: The coffee's own description — the roaster's tasting notes, the dialing approach that worked. Per bag notes go in bag_notes.

opened_date.description: Calendar day in YYYY-MM-DD format — a day, not a timestamp

elevation_max_m.description: Upper end of an elevation range, e.g. 1980 for "1800–1980 m"; elevation_m is the lower end

roast_date.description: Calendar day in YYYY-MM-DD format — a day, not a timestamp

sweetness.description: Free text; roasters usually say low, medium or high

unfrozen_at.description: Calendar day the bag came out, YYYY-MM-DD — a day, not a timestamp

name: register_coffee
title: Register a coffee
